questions.q: What is the main difference between Tableau Desktop and Tableau Public?
options: Desktop can save workbooks privately and connect to more data sources; Public only saves publicly to the web and supports fewer connectors
They are the exact same application with different names
Public is the professional paid version and Desktop is the free version
Desktop only works on Windows and Public only works on Mac
questions.explain: Tableau Desktop is the full paid authoring tool with private saves and broad connectivity; Tableau Public is free but every workbook is published publicly and it supports fewer data sources.

questions.q: Why does this course have you install Tableau Public in addition to Tableau Desktop?
options: Chapters 17-18 have you build portfolio dashboards, and Tableau Public is the free way to host them online with a shareable link
Tableau Public is required to complete any of the exercises in Chapters 1-13
Tableau Desktop cannot open .twbx files, only Tableau Public can
Tableau Public replaces the need for a Desktop trial license entirely
questions.explain: Tableau Public exists in this course's install list specifically for the portfolio-hosting need that comes up in Chapters 17-18, not for the day-to-day lessons before that.

questions.q: How do you get access to the full-featured Tableau Desktop for this course without an existing license?
options: Download the free 14-day trial from Tableau's product page
You cannot use Tableau Desktop without a corporate license
Install Tableau Public and it automatically unlocks Desktop features
Trial licenses are no longer offered by Tableau
questions.explain: Tableau offers a free 14-day full-featured trial of Desktop, which is enough to get through this course's early chapters while you decide on a longer-term license.

questions.q: What does the 'Public Edition' label in the installer screen confirm?
options: That you are installing Tableau Public, not Tableau Desktop
That the installation is free forever with no restrictions at all
That the software will only run for 14 days
That you must create a SQL Server connection before continuing
questions.explain: Because the two installers look nearly identical, the 'Public Edition' badge in the installer is the visual cue that tells you which application you're actually installing.

questions.q: Which data source limitation is specific to Tableau Public, not Tableau Desktop?
options: Tableau Public cannot make live connections to database servers like SQL Server
Tableau Public cannot open Excel files at all
Tableau Public cannot save any file to disk
Tableau Public requires a purchased license to open
questions.explain: Tableau Public supports a smaller set of connectors and has no live database connections — it's built for public, file-based data rather than private enterprise sources.
